publicationStmt.p: Working authority file for the Digital Corpus of Armenian Colophons. Publication details and licensing will be established for the corpus.

sourceDesc.p: Person records will be compiled from reviewed colophon witnesses and supporting scholarship. Each identification will retain its supporting evidence.

projectDesc.p: This file records the identities of persons referenced across the corpus. Contextual roles and claims are recorded in the relevant colophon files. Collective identities referenced by those files are recorded here as personGrp.

editorialDecl.p: Person identifiers follow the pattern pers-000001. Allocate each identifier once and retain it when names or identifications change.

Use persName elements for preferred names and variant spellings. Record Armenian forms and transliterations when supported by evidence. The values preferred and variant on persName/@type are project conventions.

Use note elements for identification and uncertainty, bibl elements for supporting references, and idno elements for verified external identifiers. Omit unavailable optional fields rather than supply empty values.

Use person for individuals and personGrp for collective identities. Classification notes distinguish historical persons and sacred figures. These labels describe record kinds, not contextual roles. Sacred identifies figures represented as divine or sacred in the texts. Preserve group labels as used in the source without assuming fixed membership or equivalence between different labels.
Bibliographical references will point to bibliography.xml with the appropriate record fragment.

revisionDesc.change: Added thirteen individual records and ten collective records for the two test colophons.
